name: Fulvous parrotbill
extract: The fulvous parrotbill (Suthora fulvifrons) is a species of bird in the family Paradoxornithidae. The species is also known as the fulvous-fronted parrotbill, the fulvous-fronted suthora, and the fulvous-fronted crowtit. The species, along with several others from the genus Suthora, is sometimes placed in the genus Paradoxornis. The species has four subspecies; the nominate subspecies from central Nepal, Bhutan and north-east India; P. f. chayulensis from north India and south China; P. f. albifacies  from north Burma and nearby south China, and P. f. cyanophrys from central China.
